descriptions.notStarted: I think I have gotten quite familiar with producing items, and I am sure Meren would be shocked to see my prowess in it. Right at that time, Meren called me and told me if I ever had anything to do in Magatia, make sure to stop by and see him.
descriptions.inProgress:
I wound up heading to Magatia after seeing Meren's message. As soon as I saw him, however, instead of a hearty hug, he gave me a huge scolding. Apparently, he saw one of the items I made at the Free Market, and he was so disgusted by my poor quality of work that he vowed to set me straight by giving me a test.
The test is actually making an Intermediate Monster Crystal. Hmmm... this is quite intense.

descriptions.completed: Meren gave me a lecture on how I had become complacent, and told me I had to start again from scratch. After passing his test by successfully creating the Intermediate Monster Crystal, he let me go, and I realized my item-producing skills have gotten that much better as a result of his words.
